text:
Priya Kapoor: Quick FYI — Team from CloudPartner asked for a tiny "cookbook" to onboard Redwood models to their marketplace. Goal: one Terraform module + minimal example repo they can plug into CI. Need to support (1) AMI/container option, (2) VPC peering + private endpoints, (3) basic autoscaling + health checks. Any objections to starting a 1-pager + starter module?
Leah Park: love it. can we include a conformance checklist too? e.g., required outputs, tagging, MFA for deploy, audit logs.
Jason Ortiz: I can sketch a module skeleton. Suggest pattern: module exposes `service_type = "container" | "ami"`, `network_module` reference, and `monitoring_enabled` flag. keep provider aliases minimal.
Priya Kapoor: perfect. partner wants an azure + aws example. start with aws first?
Tom Rivera: (CloudPartner) aws-first works for us. our customers are mostly on EKS but a simple AMI path is required for baremetal partners. also need a preflight check for instance sizes + ami-compat.
Leah Park: noted. checklist items I want: 1) outputs: service_endpoint, security_group_ids, iam_roles. 2) terraform fmt & validate in CI 3) smoke test: /health + sample prompt 4) cost estimate step (rough) 5) automated rollback hook on failed canary.
Jason Ortiz: putting a quick module snippet here for discussion:
```hcl
variable "service_type" { type = string default = "container" }
module "network" { source = "git::https://git.internal/redwood/terraform-modules//vpc" }
resource "aws_ecs_service" "inference" {
  count      = var.service_type == "container" ? 1 : 0
  name       = "redwood-inference-${var.env}"
  cluster    = module.cluster.cluster_id
  desired_count = var.desired_count
}
output "service_endpoint" { value = aws_lb.redwood.dns_name }
```
Jason Ortiz: also plan to include a tiny smoke harness (Go binary + curl) that calls /v1/generate with test prompt and verifies tokenized length.
Priya Kapoor: @Leah Park can you draft the conformance checklist doc? put it in partnership repo under /cookbooks/marketplace-onboard/CHECKLIST.md. I'll loop in partner PMs after draft.
Leah Park: on it — will include CI snippets (GitHub Actions), a sample policy for least-privilege IAM, and a small terraform plan size check.
Tom Rivera: quick Q: will module expose a toggle for private endpoint only (no public internet)? some of our customers require air-gapped egress.
Jason Ortiz: yes — expose `endpoint_visibility = "private" | "public"` and wire ALB or NLB accordingly. include docs for Interface Endpoint + Route53 private zone.
Priya Kapoor: deployment owner: Jason will own module skeleton, Leah will own checklist + tests, I will coordinate partner review + announcement wording. Tom please share your internal packaging constraints (artifact naming, SBOM reqs).
Tom Rivera: will do. sending packaging reqs shortly. thanks! :raised_hands:
InfraBot: deploy-bot: created branch partnerships/marketplace-cookbook/1746009876 and scaffolded repo in git.internal/redwood/partnerships/marketplace-cookbook
Leah Park: ack, I'll add CI jobs and smoke test workflow.
Jason Ortiz: I'll push initial module PR by EOD tomorrow.
Priya Kapoor: great — aim to have partner preview by EOW. if blockers, post here. :calendar:
Tom Rivera: thanks everyone, excited to get this in marketplace.
Leah Park: one more note — add a short section 'how to test quantized models' (cpu runtimes) so partner SIs don't brick smaller instances.
Priya Kapoor: good call. add to checklist.
Jason Ortiz: noted, will include small ci job to run quantized inference on t4g-like instance in parallel.
Priya Kapoor: closing — action items in the branch README and I'll open a tracking card in JIRA.
